verdict.rationale: The Core API's availability check handles up to 50 domain names in one call, and the website offers Bulk Domain Search. A user also reports selecting 50 domains at once in the UI to change nameservers. However, the documented write endpoints (create domain, add DNS record, transfer, email forwarding) are all single-item, so bulk mutations via API or MCP would need client-side looping. Missing for 10: documented bulk write or batch API endpoints (e.g., bulk DNS, bulk renew or transfer), bulk operations exposed through the MCP server, and independent corroboration of programmatic bulk workflows.
